finalText:
Build's clean now (exit 0, 0 errors). The wall of noise was mostly harmless deprecation warnings from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.), but two real regressions were hiding in there and actually broke the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }`. Updated it to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it was throwing on every unset flag. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the dependency bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) — not actionable, and the build now exits 0.
